ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ السَّارِيْ سِرُّهُ فِيْ سَائِرِ الْكَائِنَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, as-Sārī sirruhū fī sā’iri ‘l-kā’ināt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family whose secret penetrates the depths of existence!
blocks.review: سِرُّهُ: mark over final hā drawn like an ordinary ḍamma (not clearly inverted), transcribed as ḍamma.

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَكَفِّرْ بِهَا عَنَّا السَّيِّئَاتِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa kaffir bi hā `an na ‘s-sayyi’āt.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and thereby hide our faults!
